name: Royal Recruits

meta.level_note: Tournament standard. King tower and princess towers are also level 11.

units.coordinate_system: origin at arena center; x runs left-right, y runs along the lane; own side is y < 0

provenance_legend.app: read by the user from the Clash Royale app
provenance_legend.liquipedia: Liquipedia Clash Royale wiki, evolution page, level 11 row
provenance_legend.derived: computed from other fields in this file
provenance_legend.design_decision: rule chosen for the simulator because no public source states it; verify in-game

unit_tables.speed_tier_note: slow = 0.75 tiles/s is 37.5 millitiles/tick, so it is stored as 37. Not used by this card; resolve the rounding rule before any slow card is added.

spawn.cursor_position: midpoint between the two center recruits (x = 0 in formation space)
spawn.rigid_formation_note: Never compressed or slid inward. The cursor is clamped instead (see placement).

cursor_x_window_millitiles.note: tile edges of the 4 legal columns; matches the in-app +/-2000 limit

placement.cursor_x_derivation: the outer recruit sits 7000 from the cursor and its 500 radius must stay inside the 9000 boundary, so |cursor_x| <= 1500 (cursor is a tile center)
placement.outer_recruit_edge_at_limit: 8500 + 500 = 9000, exactly on the boundary, so nothing overhangs
placement.cursor_y: tile centers inside arena.json deployment.friendly_base_zone, excluding river, bridges and own tower footprints
placement.pocket_rule: may only be deployed in an enemy pocket after BOTH enemy princess towers are destroyed (see arena.json deployment.pocket_zones)
placement.edge_rule: No separate edge rule. Restricting the cursor to 4 columns is the edge rule; the formation is never compressed or slid.

shield.overflow_rule: any single hit that breaks the shield removes only the shield; all excess damage is discarded regardless of size

evolution.stats_note: Evo stats equal base stats except for charge. Liquipedia's evolution page also lists 547 HP, 240 shield, 133 damage and 266 charge damage at level 11.

activation.player_choice_note: While EVO_READY every play is the evo version, so the RL action space needs no extra evo action.
activation.ready_flag_changes_when: at the end of the normal play. The card cannot be played again until it re-enters the hand, so this matches 'evo-ready after re-entering the hand'.
activation.observation_recommendation: expose evo_ready for each of the 4 hand slots and the next card
activation.next_card_slot_display: unverified: check in-app whether the next-card preview already shows the evo form

charge.provenance_note: 2.5 tiles confirmed by Supercell October 2025 balance notes (Prince, Evolved Royal Recruits, Ram Rider). Charge speed and damage match Liquipedia.
charge.distance_metric: path length actually moved, summed per tick
charge.slowed_movement_counts: only the distance actually moved is added to progress
charge.after_reset: the recruit must move 2500 millitiles to charge again
charge.reset_list_provenance: design_decision, built from the user's in-game rules

attack_timing_after_reset_or_charged_hit.note: Supercell's October 2025 bug fix removed the instant first attack after a charge reset (affects Evolved Royal Recruits). So the normal attack timing applies after a reset.
attack_timing_after_reset_or_charged_hit.rule: after a charged hit the next attack follows the normal 26-tick hit speed; after a reset with no charged hit the normal 10-tick first-hit delay applies

effects_reference.note: Slow and stun values belong to the cards that cause them. Listed here only so the charge rules can reference them.

ice_wizard.provenance: supercell, October 2025 (35% to 30%); the same change also covered Fisherman, Giant Snowball and Ice Golem

effects_reference.durations_and_percentages: not stored here; take them from each card's own data file

unverified: Spawn offsets (-7000, -4000, -500, 500, 4000, 7000) are your in-game measurement; no public source lists them.
Charge distance counted as path length, not straight-line distance.
Next-card slot showing the evo form before the card is in hand.
That stopping to make a normal attack always resets charge progress, and that a freeze behaves like a stun.
Ice Wizard 30% slow is from October 2025; check it against the current version.
Tile-snapped cursor: spawn offsets are measured from the snapped tile center (this is why the legal cursor x values are -1500, -500, 500, 1500).
Cursor y range depends on the pocket geometry still missing from arena.json.
